answer: Peer audit blocks fakes. Each identity locks 300 credits, filing receipts at a wharf ledger, one key per receipt. Each epoch a beacon picks 5%; three peers replay the work, and any delta between claim and proof burns the bond on two agreeing votes, half as bounty. Fraud opens a spiral of re-audits catching rented-audit rings. 1,000 fakes lock 300,000, bleeding 15,000 an epoch against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 300 once, keeping share.
